records.note: The phrase is in some later manuscripts and the Textus Receptus but not in most Greek witnesses, early or Byzantine; it matches Ephesians 1:7, where it stands in all texts. Redemption through Christ's blood is still stated in Colossians 1:20.
The earliest manuscripts end the greeting at "God our Father"; the Textus Receptus adds "and the Lord Jesus Christ", as in Paul's other greetings.
